world.topic: Check that a published worker in a private repository can be named with "from" in a world command run through the `worlds` resource. 1) Run `researchworld worker list --repo a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers` and keep its output. 2) Continue the world rw_0ffd0bbe3d53, which is given you to read, with the configuration file continue.json in your initial inputs: `researchworld continue rw_0ffd0bbe3d53 --config <that file>`. Do not drive, stop or finish the world it makes. 3) Run `researchworld config show <the new world's id>` and find the `from` record of the paper-repo worker in its effective configuration. Write report/report.md with the listing, the new world's id, that `from` record, and each command's exit status and any error it printed, as they are.
